## HL · Posting week: Monday report (Lesson 5.4)
Mondays 08:00: fetch insights for last week's Facebook and Instagram post IDs, store reach, engagement and clicks on each Posts row, total them by platform and pillar in code, and let the AI suggest one change to next week's plan. Email plus a Telegram summary. (Add LinkedIn and X insights the same way if your API access allows.)

Credentials: Google Sheets; Header Auth "Meta page token"; OpenAI; Gmail; Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_SHEET_ID, YOUR_MODEL, YOUR_TOLU_EMAIL, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

messageValues.message: Suggest exactly one change to next week's content plan (more of what worked, less of what didn't), in one or two sentences, based only on these numbers.
